summary: Verified CSS-only dark mode fix for Home page. All assertions from the review request passed: light→dark→light toggle works, home-page bg correctly switches to rgb(19,27,31) with fg rgb(244,247,250) and card bg rgb(28,38,43); mandala watermark remains present; toggle back returns to rgb(245,247,250). Regression pages (/pricing, /how-to-use, /glow-up) remain in their original light styling regardless of the .dark class on <html>, as the fix was intentionally scoped to '.dark .alu-s[data-testid="home-page"]' only.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal (single scoped CSS block in shared-pages.css lines 30-53) and correctly mirrors the .dark palette from index.css. Palette values align with the hsl tokens (bg #131b1f ≈ hsl(200 18% 10%), card #1c262b ≈ hsl(200 18% 14%)).

Note for the future: other .alu-s pages (PricingPage, GlowUpPage, HowToUsePage, AdminPage) do NOT respond to the dark class since the base .alu-s rule hard-codes light-mode variables. Currently intentional per user request ('all the other pages look good') but if a future request extends dark mode site-wide, it will be simpler to move the dark overrides to a generic '.dark .alu-s' selector.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Dark mode toggle on HomePage confirmed working end-to-end. Test used the [data-testid='dark-mode-toggle'] in Navigation and validated computed backgroundColor/color on [data-testid='home-page']. Regression pages verified as unchanged (still light) which matches the intentional scope of the fix.
rca of the issue: Original bug: .alu-s wrapper set --bg/--card/--fg to light hex values with no .dark override, so toggling dark mode only affected the top Navigation (which uses index.css .dark tokens) while the HomePage body stayed light. Fix mirrors the .dark palette tokens onto the CSS variables consumed by HomePage — verified via computed styles.
